Definition: from the middle voice of a compound of G1909 and G4921; a conspiracy, i.e. concourse (riotous or friendly):--that which cometh upon, + raising up.
BiblicalUsage: Episystasis is a coming upon, a conspiracy, a pressure that crowds in. Paul says, beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches; and he answers his accusers that they neither found him in the temple disputing, nor raising up the people.
TheologicalSignificance: Not one crisis, but the care of all the churches, coming upon him every day: that is the apostle's real burden.
